notes:
Summary: Mid-market product team (search + discovery SaaS). Exploring Redwood Hosted API for reranking POC, with plan to move to Dedicated if quality and cost targets met. AE: Alex Chen, SE: Priya Raman.

Background / Context:
- Product: enterprise-facing product discovery/search layer used by e-commerce and B2B marketplaces. Heavy long-tail queries, lots of noisy titles/descriptions.
- Current stack: Elastic + BM25 for candidate generation; lightweight vector similarity for ~top-200. Teams want to add a reranker to improve top-k relevance and long-tail recall.

Engagement timeline (key events):
- 2026-01-20: Lead created after intro form; initial discovery call booked.
- 2026-01-25: Intro call (Alex) — interested in Redwood hosted API for quick test. Wants rerank endpoint specifically.
- 2026-02-01: Demo (Priya) — walkthrough of hosted rerank endpoint, streaming, and batch/offline scoring options. Shared example repo.
- 2026-02-05: POC kickoff call (Fireflies ff_20260205_1234). Agreed scope: offline rerank of top-50 candidates for 10k eval queries + online A/B on subset of traffic.
- 2026-02-10: Dataset uploaded to Drive (rerank-eval-2026-02.xlsx). SE provided eval harness and sample scoring scripts.
- 2026-02-18: Mid-POC check-in, latency tests run against hosted API (ff_20260218_0900). Observed p50 ~120ms, p95 ~310ms for 50-candidate rerank at current test load.
- 2026-02-25: Offline eval complete; NDCG@10 uplift ~+9% over baseline. Team requested pricing for Hosted at scale and pricing/architecture for Dedicated.

Requirements / goals (from product & eng):
- Primary workload: reranking top-50 candidate lists (offline scoring + online rerank API).
- Quality target: +10% NDCG@10 vs current BM25+vector baseline (they view +8-12% as success).
- Latency target: online rerank p95 < 300ms for 50 candidates; p50 < 150ms.
- Throughput: initial online QPS ~5-20 (spiky), offline scoring batch jobs ~100k queries/day.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; target blended cost <$0.02/query for rerank at anticipated volume.
- Model preferences: open to community LLMs and Redwood-verified variants; want ability to fallback to cheaper model variant for lower-priority traffic.
- Routing/fallback: need policy support to route to cheaper model or regionally based on load.

Security / compliance asks:
- SOC2 required (they already require vendor SOC2).
- SSO/SAML for Console access.
- Audit logs for inference requests and admin actions.
- Data residency note: several enterprise customers require EU residency — legal wants confirmation before committing to Dedicated with EU region.
- KMS for key management a plus.

POC configuration & notes:
- Using Hosted API for POC to accelerate time-to-value. Offline scoring run via Airflow pointing at hosted rerank endpoint.
- Eval set: ~10k queries curated from production logs (long-tail emphasis), relevance labels via internal raters.
- Metrics tracked: NDCG@1/3/10, MRR, latency p50/p95, cost per query.
- Early results promising (NDCG@10 +9%); main concern is p95 latency spikes and cost at scale.

Commercial conversation:
- Product team asked for pricing for both Hosted at target QPS and for a Dedicated baseline (monthly committed throughput). Want templated SOW and cost model showing break-even points.
- AE to send Hosted vs Dedicated pricing + recommended config (GPU type, reserved capacity) by 2026-03-05.

Quotes / direct feedback:
- "Biggest lift will be quality in long-tail queries; if reranker nails that we're happy to move to dedicated." — Product Lead (Maya).
- "Need a clear migration path from Hosted to Dedicated w/o rework to eval harness or prompts." — Engineering Manager (Sam).

Next steps (short):
- Alex to deliver Hosted vs Dedicated pricing and committed config (by 2026-03-05).
- SE (Priya) to validate p95 improvements with kernel/runtime suggestions (quantization profiles / batching) and propose config for Dedicated to meet latency targets.
- Legal to confirm EU residency options before procurement.

Potential blockers: security/data residency, ensuring p95 latency under peak, cost per-query at scale.

Other artifacts: pricing deck link (drive:/deals/rankly/price-proposal-v1), eval spreadsheet (drive:/poc/rankly/rerank-eval-2026-02.xlsx), security FAQ (drive:/security/rankly/security-faq.pdf).

Overall sentiment: positive — technical buy-in from Eng/Product after strong offline gains; procurement/legal work now the gating factor for Dedicated.
